content: WCAG 2.2 requires visible alternatives when color conveys meaning; 4.5:1 contrast for normal text and 3:1 for large text; 3:1 for meaningful UI visuals and states; visible keyboard focus, with Focus Appearance recommending a 2px-equivalent indicator and 3:1 state contrast. Reflow guidance explicitly allows a side-by-side code-diff region to scroll horizontally, while surrounding controls and prose must reflow and drawers must remain operable.
